http/proxy_request#

The requests a client sends to a proxy: a forwarded request in absolute form, or CONNECT for a tunnel.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The requests a client sends to a proxy: a forwarded request in absolute form, or CONNECT for a tunnel. Proxied uses them.
